SELECT count(*) AS web_lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_receipt_lines,
       min(f.sale_date) AS min_sale, max(f.sale_date) AS max_sale, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lines_no_order,
       sum(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatched_lines,
       sum(CASE WHEN o.status NOT IN ('delivered','collected') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_status_lines,
       min(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS min_dispatch,
       max(CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)) AS max_dispatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2025-11-03' AS start_date, DATE '2026-10-04' AS end_date),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT p.sku, w.dispatch_date AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.quantity AS units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.sku, r.return_date, -r.refund_net, -r.quantity_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT n.sku, SUM(n.net_sales) AS web_net_sales, SUM(n.units) AS net_units
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT a.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, ROUND(a.web_net_sales,2) AS web_net_sales, a.net_units,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC) AS rnk
FROM agg a JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = a.sku AND cp.is_current
ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 15
